title: Scoreboard
description: A simple team scoreboard for any paper, board or speaking activity: +1 / -1 per team.

title: Tag-Team Talk / Debate
description: Relay talk (M.1, M.2) and FOR vs AGAINST debate (M.3) with topic spinner, huddle and turn timer, speaking-order lane with your teams, +3 Win / +1 Challenge scoring.

title: Word Rush
description: Teams write as many words as they can for a prompt before the timer ends. Bonus cards change the scoring each round. Prompts for M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Think Tank Showdown
description: Critical-thinking game show: Riddle Rush, Spot the Problem, What Would Happen If…?, Final Wager. Questions for M.1, M.2 and M.3.

title: Talk Timer
description: Big classroom timer. Presets with one or more phases (for example 1:00 talk + 0:10 change over), a chime at zero. Edit your own presets.

title: Name Picker / Hot Seat
description: Spins a random present student. Nobody is picked twice until everyone has had a turn (remembered for the day). Optional question card and +1 / +2.

title: Sentence Scramble Race
description: A sentence appears as shuffled word tiles. Teams write it correctly on paper. First three correct teams get 3 / 2 / 1 points, then Reveal.

title: Board Race
description: A task appears (verb forms, a category, idioms). One runner per team writes on the whiteboard before time runs out. You tap points per team.
